title: Mateus Palace
scope: The standing Mateus Palace in Vila Real, Portugal, including the stepped entrance court, open service court, garden elevation, and adjoining Nossa Senhora dos Prazeres Chapel.
limitations: Small relief details, the rear chapel roof and less visible wall sections are generalized. The house and chapel exterior compose one model.

The coarse surface model retains vegetation returns and does not resolve stair treads or garden retaining levels. Gardens, water features and detached estate outbuildings are beyond the building scope.
